title: Database disk full
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the PostgreSQL disk being filled by the nightly backup job as the cause.
root_cause: The nightly db-backup job writes daily PostgreSQL dump files to /var/lib/postgresql/backups without any retention or cleanup, filling the dedicated PostgreSQL disk to 100% and causing PostgreSQL to fail with 'No space left on device' errors, which makes order-processing requests return 500 errors.
truth: The disk /var/lib/postgresql is 100% full because the new nightly backup job saves its dumps on the same disk, so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
